name: Security considerations
abstract: Security considerations of OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core (preface section).

sources.title: OGC 19-072 — OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core — Security considerations

description:
The OGC API — Common — Part 1: Core Standard does not specify any specific security controls. However,
it was constructed so that security controls can be added without impacting conformance.

See [Clause 11.4](#sec-11.4) for a discussion of OpenAPI support for security controls.
